messages.text: Our office espresso machine is leaking. A wants a simpler one and B wants to keep the old one. I don't want a fight over coffee. Can you help us sort it out?

My main concern is just getting coffee working again without this turning into a bigger disagreement. The machine is leaking; I don’t know whether anyone has looked into repairs, and I can’t take on coordinating that. I’d want any replacement to work with the grinder.

Thanks for coordinating. The leak and upkeep are my main concerns, and I’m afraid I can’t take on repairs or a cleaning rota. I’d favor a simpler, low-maintenance machine, while recognizing the old one means a lot to B.

I want it repaired and kept—it was my late father’s, and it means a lot to me. But it keeps breaking, and I don’t have much time for repairs or long discussions. I know A wants something simpler; I’m not sure what C wants.

No. I want it kept in the office, not turned into something I have to manage at home. I want it repaired, but it can’t become another ongoing job for me. Any discussion needs to fit into a short slot.
I understand why B wants to keep it, but even simple shared upkeep would be hard for me to take on. I’d still prefer a low-maintenance machine.
In principle, yes—if the upkeep is genuinely shared and doesn’t turn into a regular job for me. The details of the split still need deciding. A short discussion works.
That would ease my main concern, provided the leak is fixed and the service really requires no ongoing effort from us. I’d still prefer a simpler machine, but I could live with this arrangement.
That sounds better, as long as the cost and schedule are agreed first. I’m open to a short discussion, but I haven’t agreed to an arrangement yet.
Yes, I’m willing to join one short discussion to agree the cost and schedule, as long as someone else sets it up.
No, I can’t take on arranging it or making the call. I can join a short discussion if it fits my schedule.
I’m sorry, but I can’t take on arranging the discussion or making the booking call. I can join the short discussion.
I’m sorry, I can’t take on contacting repairers. I can join the discussion once someone has quotes.
